newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures continue to rise after auction.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures continue to rise after auction.

text.p: Dec 19 - U.S. debt futures continued to rise after the five-yr note auction. Some traders said the auction was average, but said short-covering emerged in the pits. March T-bonds bounced to 113-04/32, through resistance at 113-03/32. March Euros held gains at 94.46. June Euros were trading near highs.
